Harsh temperatures, dust, grease, and mechanical vibration

Thermal bi-spectrum CCTV cameras for early fire hazard and equipment overheating detection
Armored multi-strand single-mode fiber optic backbone in heavy-duty GI conduit
Explosion-proof and weather-resistant IP66/IP67 surveillance enclosures

AI perimeter tripwire CCTV with audio warning strobe lights
Industrial Ethernet DIN-rail switches with wide operating temperatures
High-bay LED lighting with motion sensor zone automation

Strict regulatory compliance for physical server access and audit logging

solutions: Cold aisle and hot aisle containment systems with sliding security doors
MPO/MTP ultra-low loss pre-terminated fiber trunk assemblies
Biometric palm-vein and facial recognition dual-auth mantraps
Aspirating smoke detection (VESDA) and clean-agent Novec 1230 fire suppression
deliverables: Server rack enclosures (42U/48U) with integrated intelligent vertical PDUs
High-density overhead fiber raceway and wire mesh cable containment
VESDA early-warning air sampling smoke detection and gas suppression
Server cage partitioning with biometric access logs and dual-custody controls
Environmental monitoring for temperature, humidity, water leak, and airflow
OTDR fiber characterization with Tier-2 certification test reports
